teacher: Offline exact-state teacher chooses an arm with kinematic solutions for start and goal, then physically approaches. At 2.3 simulated seconds, after the declared push, it replans the hover/descent from the displaced bottle. This is a privileged recovery demonstration; inference never calls this teacher.
destinations: Explicitly add the requested bottle destination to layout.targets. The original 24 nominal episodes did not apply this request; their reports remain preserved and are labeled fallback-goal data.
replay: Independently replay the saved float32 20 Hz endpoints with the identical disclosed force schedule, preserving physical contact/release/parking checks. Every failed or refused attempt remains in the denominator.
selection: These are reserved training seeds, not physical development or evaluation seeds. No checkpoint promotion is implied by teacher success.
